interpretation_rules: full372 means the actual unfiltered six-scenario mesh 60 empty-filter 1.2 command, including original 90-step primary fast-box continuation.
selected193 means the three curved scenarios only, generally mesh 1 trough, with original 90-step primary fast-box continuation; it is not the full372 suite.
entry193 uses the selected curved scenarios and the explicit entry flag: primary fast boxes run two arrival steps; independent controls retain their original code.

Prepared-only source metadata is historical; actual execution claims are tied to the later run receipts and logs listed here.
No human validation, persistence closure, platform closure or performance acceptance follows from these automated scoped results.
